title: Synchronize PRD acceptance & sign-off for Dedicated Autoscale V2
creator: Maya Chen
description: This ticket coordinates cross-team reviews and final acceptance criteria for the Dedicated Autoscale V2 PRD. The PRD introduces an autoscaling controller for dedicated GPU pools (predictable throughput + burst), API additions to management plane (scalePolicy object), console UX for per-pool autoscale configuration, and contract-level billing language for burst and reserved capacity. We need engineering, design, and legal to review and sign off on scope, API shape, UX copy, and billing/contract implications before scheduling the canary rollout. This ticket captures outstanding questions, decisions, and the final sign-off checklist.
acceptance_criteria: Design: final Figma mocks for pool-level autoscale modal reviewed and approved by PM and Eng; accessibility checklist passed.
Engineering: API spec (OpenAPI) for scalePolicy validated; backward-compatible for existing clients; integration tests in staging demonstrate scaling under synthetic load.
Engineering: Autoscale controller handles KV cache eviction gracefully and preserves per-request latency SLOs (95th p99 within thresholds) during scale events.
Legal: Billing language for burst charges and reserved capacity added to contract template; DPA/data-retention implications documented and approved.
Product: Rollout plan with canary group, metrics burn-in, and rollback criteria documented in the PRD and linked runbook.
Operations: Monitoring dashboards for scale events, error rates, and cost delta created and reviewed by SRE.
All: Formal sign-off recorded from PM, Eng lead, Design lead, and Legal counsel in this ticket comments and signoffs field.
decisions: Scope trimmed to exclude per-tenant predictive autoscaling in initial ship; will be delivered as part of Autoscale+ (Q3).
Autoscale API will expose a single scalePolicy object with min/max/target_utilization and optional cooldown window rather than multiple policy types to reduce complexity.
Billing model: reserved capacity continues to be invoiced monthly; burst consumption billed hourly at a pre-negotiated multiplier; legal to finalize exact phrasing.
Design to reuse existing pool settings modal and surface new autoscale options as an advanced section to minimize onboarding friction.
